title: Git Namespaces — Reseat Namespace — payload
description: A community administrator recovers a headless bound namespace — one with no live git.ns.admin — by granting git.ns.admin on it to a current member. Refused unless the namespace is headless.

subject.description: The current member who receives git.ns.admin on the namespace. May be the administrator themselves.

statement.description: Why the namespace is being reseated and why to this member, in the administrator's words. Kept in the audit record, recorded as the new right's `reason`, and shown to the namespace's repository owners.

Response.title: Git Namespaces — Reseat Namespace — response payload

right.description: The git.ns.admin record the reseat created. It never carries `expiresAt`.
